podcast.body: This album was the biggest selling album of 2000, achieving sales of 10 million copies. Its success predated the most dramatic impacts of widespread digital file-sharing on album sales. "The biggest selling album of 2000 was InSync's No Strings Attached with 10 million copies."

podcast.title: Best-Selling Album of the Year
podcast.body: Released in 2000, *No Strings Attached* by the boy band NSYNC was the highest-selling album of that year, which was also the peak year for Compact Disc sales historically. This album represents the commercial zenith of the CD format before its rapid decline. "el disco más vendido de ese año había sido el de la Boys Van Enzinc."

Released 308 days after the Backstreet Boys' record-breaking album, this album set an even higher sales record for a boy band, selling 2.4 million copies by the end of its first week in stores. "By the end of its first week in the stores, there are no strings attached to albums sold 2.4 million copies."
